Data:Ally.carapace.json.label: The Institute's Ally: the Carapace Cross
Data:Ally.carapace.json.desc: The Institute will work with the Carapace Cross, as their return begins.

Data:Ally.chandler.json.label: The Institute's Ally: the Chandler
Data:Ally.chandler.json.desc: The institute will work with the Chandler... when the Chandler finally becomes manifest.

Data:Ally.none.json.label: The Institute's Ally: None
Data:Ally.none.json.desc: The founders of the Institute couldn't agree on who to work with.

Data:Ally.reckoners.json.label: The Institute's Ally: the Reckoner Lords
Data:Ally.reckoners.json.desc: The Institute will work with the merchants of years - cautiously, but profitably.

Data:Ally.ys.json.label: The Institute's Ally: Ys
Data:Ally.ys.json.desc: The Institute will work with Ys... when it is useful.

Data:Almonds.json.Label: Almonds
Data:Almonds.json.Desc: [Add Sugar and spice to make Jumble.]

xexts.scrutiny: [Today will always be the day you learnt that the ripening almond-fruit is called drupe, unless you were already wise in the almond lore.]

Data:Ambergris.json.Label: Ambergris Chunk
Data:Ambergris.json.Desc: Never, never, never call it 'whale vomit'.

xexts.scrutiny: Were I being polite, I would call the scent 'musky'.

Data:Ampoule.amethyst.json.Label: Amethyst Ampoule
Data:Ampoule.amethyst.json.Desc: Were it released from the glass, it would be quite another colour.

xexts.scrutiny: A violet stain; then nothing. [There are Prentice-level Knock recipes that can craft this.]

Data:Ampoule.wolfsnow.json.Label: Wolf-Snow Ampoule
Data:Ampoule.wolfsnow.json.Desc: Far too cold ever to melt in anything but the hottest noonday sun. It will, very gradually, consume human flesh.

xexts.scrutiny: I recall a prophecy of war: 'a war in which each flame will find its fuel.' Or was the prophecy mine?

Data:Apple.charlotte.json.Label: Apple Charlotte
Data:Apple.charlotte.json.Desc: A classic English pudding of apples stewed with cinnamon and layered with crisp golden bread.

Data:Appointment.enigmatic.json.label: Secretary Enigmatic
Data:Appointment.enigmatic.json.desc: The Secretary Enigmatic conceals or reveals the Institute's secrets.

Data:Appointment.nunciant.json.label: Secretary Nunciant
Data:Appointment.nunciant.json.desc: The Secretary Nunciant communicates and negotiates with other organisations.

Data:Appointment.persistent.json.label: Secretary Persistent
Data:Appointment.persistent.json.desc: The Secretary Persistent is ultimately responsible for the Institute's continuity.

Data:Appointment.salvant.json.label: Secretary Salvant
Data:Appointment.salvant.json.desc: The Secretary Salvant leads the Institute's healing and restoration efforts.

Data:Appointment.treasurer.json.label: Treasurer
Data:Appointment.treasurer.json.desc: The Treasurer is responsible for the Institute's finances.

Data:Appointment.vigilant.json.label: Secretary Vigilant
Data:Appointment.vigilant.json.desc: The Secretary Vigilant ensures the Institute's safety.

xexts.scrutiny: Ambrose Westcott was a capacious gentleman, and he ensured the springs in this his fortress were calibrated to bear any conceivable weight. Two hundred years on, the springs still do their duty.

Data:Armchair.knock.json.Label: Staff Armchair
Data:Armchair.knock.json.Desc: Polished by the posteriors of dozens of loafing prison guards.

xexts.scrutiny: For a great many years this chair sat below a dartboard. The leather is pocked with the marks of occasional misses (or, just possibly, assassination attempts.)
According to consistent tradition, this is the most comfortable chair in the entire House.
Once a favoured chair of the Treasurer of the Curia - an office that Fraser Strathcoyne often held, and much preferred to the post of Librarian.
A printed card reads: NOW PROBABLY SAFE TO SLEEP IN THIS CHAIR. G.C.
'Someone died in this chair,' I find myself thinking. There are no stains or remains; there is nothing at all to suggest that this might be true.

Data:Armchair.sky.json.Label: Kitty's Armchair
Data:Armchair.sky.json.Desc: This looks very like the armchair in which Kitty Mazarine, second Librarian, sat for El Bretón's famous group portrait.

xexts.scrutiny: Kitty Mazarine (the story goes) napped in an armchair and dreamt of mirrors. She woke to find herself humming an unknown melody. That melody became her fuging-tune 'Thirty Birds'. If this is really that armchair, it's a little bit of history.

Data:Arriving.json.label: Arriving
Data:Arriving.json.desc: (recipe aspect) - visitor has reached their destination and is no longer embarking

Data:Arsenic.json.Label: Arsenic
Data:Arsenic.json.Desc: A poison sometimes known as 'the Message of the Swan'.

Data:Arthur.json.label: Lt Arthur Thomas Moore (Ret.)
Data:Arthur.json.desc: Hero, pilgrim, traitor. He'll always be a soldier, but never again can he be only a soldier.

xexts.befriend．arthur．douglas: Arthur and Douglas will keep in cautious contact.
xexts.mistrust．arthur．coquille: Arthur will be keeping an eye on Coquille.

Data:Arthur.likes.douglas.json.desc: Arthur is fond of his newly-acquainted great-nephew, Douglas.

Data:Arthur.mistrusts.coquille.json.desc: Arthur is keeping an eye on Coquille.

Data:Arun.json.label: Dr Arun Peel
Data:Arun.json.desc: Exile, riddlemonger, Thunderskin devotee. ('I'd rather say confidant.') Impeccably dressed, but always in dark clothing so the stains don't show. Dark the dressings too at his ankles and his wrists. ('I won't take a seat. It's kind of you to offer. It would be unkind of me to accept.')

xexts.befriend．arun．coquille: Arun and Coquille have developed a cautious amity.
xexts.befriend．arun．yvette: Arun and Yvette will leave together tonight...
xexts.befriend．arun．denzil: Arun and Denzil have discreetly established an affinity.

Data:Arun.likes.coquille.json.desc: Arun has developed a cautious familial affection for Coquille.

Data:Arun.likes.denzil.json.desc: Arun is rumoured to have gone home with Denzil after a salon at Hush House.

Data:Arun.likes.yvette.json.desc: Arun is rumoured to have taken Yvette home after a salon at Hush House.

Data:Ascendant.harmony.json.Label: Ascendant Harmony
Data:Ascendant.harmony.json.Desc: A bright and ringing music which evokes the blue sweep of the lower heavens.

Data:Ashartine.json.Label: Ashartine
Data:Ashartine.json.Desc: Lies written in Ashartine tend to fade or be misspelt. It's legible in the dark. An Ink of Revelation.

xexts.scrutiny: If dark were light… [There are Keeper-level Sky and Lantern recipes that can craft this from Ichor Vitreous.]

Data:Asimel.json.Label: Asimel
Data:Asimel.json.Desc: A silver ink that can only be made and used in dreams. An Ink of Revelation.

xexts.scrutiny: A silvery glimmer like a spilt star. [Scholar-level Moon and Moth recipes exist that can craft this with lenses or liquids.]

Data:Assam.sweetened.cup.json.Label: Deep-Sweetened Assam (Cup)
Data:Assam.sweetened.cup.json.Desc: Sweetened with agave syrup and deep history.

Data:Assam.sweetened.h.json.Label: Deep-Sweetened Assam (Half-Pot)
Data:Assam.sweetened.h.json.Desc: Sweetened with agave syrup and deep history.
